item.title: IIT-B suicide case: While one group seeks accountability, another backs professor
item.description: Following the unfortunate death of a student, IIT-Bombay has placed its administrative dean on leave pending an investigation. The institution has retracted its previous statement about the circumstances surrounding the student's examination. Students are actively protesting for more decisive actions and the formation of an independent inquiry committee. The grieving family accuses the institute of abetment and harassment, seeking a CID-led investigation, as campus tensions mount.

item.title: 585kg waste gone in 4.5 hrs, Bittu Tabahi takes cleanliness mission to Delhi’s Yamuna
item.description: On September 20, Surendra Singh Choudhary, affectionately called Bittu Tabahi, spearheaded a remarkable cleanup initiative along the banks of the Yamuna river. In a dedicated four-hour effort, he and a team of volunteers successfully gathered an impressive 585 kilograms of litter. This endeavor was part of World Cleanup Day, supported by Philip Morris.
item.dc:creator: TRENDING DESK

item.title: Amazon blocks Meta's AI Agent Muse AI on its app
item.description: Amazon has decided to prevent Meta's Muse AI from making any purchases on its platform, citing important privacy and security issues. While Meta insists its AI manages user credentials safely, this conflict underscores the tension between these tech giants. The situation also emphasizes the intensifying competition for shopper engagement in the realm of digital commerce.

item.title: How Puducherry offers housing sites to homeless and underprivileged communities
item.description: Puducherry is extending its generous initiative that provides free house plots to economically disadvantaged families and those belonging to scheduled caste communities. Since its inception in 1981, the scheme supports individuals who do not have land for housing. Eligible applicants must be Indian citizens with a yearly family income below Rs 24,000 and need to present a range of documents including identity, residence, income, and caste certificates.

item.title: MrBeast defends $10M Ghana village project after backlash
item.description: MrBeast has defended his $10 million Ghana village project aimed at combating child labour after being questioned over spending overseas. The YouTuber said he “literally” supports his hometown of Greenville, North Carolina, highlighting his local philanthropy. The project includes homes, a school, clean water infrastructure, farms and other facilities for local communities.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: 13-year-old genius with 'Einstein IQ' to start NYU master's
item.description: Meet Joe Petraro-Hyppolite, a 13-year-old Long Island prodigy with a reported IQ of 168, who has been accepted into an NYU master’s programme. He scored 1590 on the SAT at 10 and graduated high school at 11. After battling leukemia and Tourette syndrome, he continues his remarkable academic journey while pursuing sports management and biology.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Florida used robot rabbits to hunt Burmese pythons threatening the Everglades
item.description: Florida is testing solar-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. Developed by the South Florida Water Management District and University of Florida, the robotic decoys mimic prey using heat and scent while AI cameras detect approaching snakes. Officials can then alert trained removal agents, adding technology to Florida’s wider python control efforts.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Horse racing fan turns $2 bets into $500K, helps rebuild Belmont Park
item.description: Meet Roger Cettina, 59, a Hall of Fame horseplayer who began with $2 teenage bets before winning nearly $500,000 in National Horseplayers Championship contests. After decades of loving Belmont Park as a fan, Cettina got the chance to help rebuild the legendary racetrack. He calls the experience an unbelievable, once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Naga teen on way to buy essentials killed in Manipur ambush
item.description: A 17-year-old Naga boy was killed in an alleged ambush by suspected Kuki militants. This incident occurred in Manipur's Tamenglong district on Monday morning. Tensions between the Naga and Kuki communities have escalated following this event. Five Kuki villagers were also killed in separate incidents involving suspected Naga militants. Several houses were torched in Naga and Kuki-inhabited areas across the state.
item.dc:creator: KANGKAN KALITA

item.title: 91-year-old woman dies after monkey attacks, pushes her in Karnataka
item.description: A 91-year-old woman named Najamunisa Begum died on Monday in Koppal district. She was allegedly attacked and pushed by a monkey while standing outside her home. The injured woman was immediately rushed to a hospital for urgent medical treatment. Sadly, she later succumbed to her severe injuries sustained during the incident. Authorities are currently investigating the precise circumstances surrounding this unfortunate monkey attack.
item.dc:creator: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI

item.title: ‘Global order under stress’: Jaishankar calls for stronger multilateralism at UNGA
item.description: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar called for stronger multilateralism at a UNGA summit. He stressed greater international cooperation to address conflicts and emerging technologies. India also co-chaired the first Partners for Multilateralism summit in New York. Slovakia backed India's bid for a permanent UN Security Council seat. The Visegrad Group plus India meeting marked a new historic occasion.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Inevitable veto power? 4 European nations back India’s permanent UN seat bid
item.description: The V4 comprises Poland, Hungary, Slovakia and Czechia. The four countries held their first ministerial-level meeting with India in the new V4+India format during the UNGA high-level week. Jaishankar described the meeting as a "new historic occasion" and said the discussions covered political, economic, defence, technology, space, connectivity and people-to-people ties.
item.dc:creator: AYUSH PANDEY

item.title: 5-day-old infant dies after fire breaks out at Telangana's RIMS hospital; 28 newborns rescued
item.description: Tragedy struck at RIMS Hospital in Adilabad when a five-day-old newborn sadly lost their life due to a fire that broke out late Monday night. Fortunately, twenty-eight children were safely evacuated from the affected ward. The flames ignited around 11:50 pm, leading to a swift response from fire services. Firefighters managed to control the situation, while police have since registered a case and are investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident.
item.dc:creator: RK LAXMI

item.title: Marriage plans in doubt, Hyderabad cop ends life after video call with fiancee
item.description: A 35-year-old police constable died by suicide late Sunday evening. He was attached to the Armed Reserve of Malkajgiri commissionerate. The constable reportedly called his fiancée before taking the extreme step. Police are probing the exact cause of his death. He was under distress after learning his marriage might not happen.

item.title: US airports resume operations after telecom outage disrupts thousands of flights
item.description: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the communications lines had been repaired and operations were gradually resuming, although passengers were still expected to face delays as airlines worked through the backlog. "The telecom lines have been repaired, and all airport operations in the Northeast are resuming," Duffy said. The outage meant that flights headed for some of the airports could not land.

item.title: Why do students study more under pressure but remember less?
item.description: Every exam season, the same scene repeats itself in homes across India. Lights stay on past midnight, notebooks pile up, and a student who has barely looked at a chapter all year suddenly spends twelve hours a day buried in it. And yet, when results come in, the outcome is often disappointing. Not because the child didn't work hard enough, but because working harder under panic and working smart under calm are two completely different things and we keep confusing one for the other.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Drones carrying ground robots: Ukraine’s new battlefield tactic against Russia
item.description: Ukraine's Operation Vivaldi expanded drone use with ground vehicles deployed by aerial bombers. These unmanned ground vehicles targeted Russian logistic nodes deep within occupied territory. Ukrainian forces recaptured significant territory using a layered approach with robotics and electronic warfare. Unmanned ground vehicles now serve critical logistics, engineering, and infantry support roles. This offensive highlights the deep integration of robotic systems into Ukraine's combat strategy.
item.dc:creator: DHRUV YADAV

item.title: 'No burden for consumers': Sitharaman clarifies who will pay MDR on UPI transactions
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed concerns over the Merchant Discount Rate charges, emphasizing that UPI users will face no additional financial burden. These charges apply solely to payment operators and do not treat consumers as taxpayers. The revised rule targets only high-value Person-to-Merchant UPI transactions, meaning most users will transact without incurring extra fees. The government has expressed its commitment to this decision, ruling out any changes.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: How Patrick and Brittany Mahomes built a $325M Kansas City sports empire
item.description: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes are building a sports business empire through investments in the Kansas City Royals, Sporting KC, Alpine F1 and KC Current. The NWSL club's valuation soared from $75 million in 2024 to $325 million in 2026, generating $36 million in annual revenue. With Patrick's off-field earnings estimated at $30 million, their ventures reflect a long-term vision beyond football.

item.title: Oil remains above $100 per barrel as traders await potential US-Iran talks
item.description: Oil prices climbed above one hundred dollars a barrel as Middle East tensions intensified. Traders weighed signs of possible US-Iran talks against continuing tensions in the Gulf. The US and Iran have traded threats for over six months now.
